BONUS SCHEDULE (public): at most one agent holds an offer in each round. Offers alternate: Lucas in rounds 1, 3, 5, ... and Omar in rounds 2, 4, 6, ...

OBJECTIVE: Maximise your own individual reward over all rounds.
